name: standard
what: The standard template (122 rows): v7 with every row text a model reads worded without tags: the cash interest paid and cash income taxes paid rows establish their basis from the printed caption and the disclosure text, the affiliate loans row reads the related-party note, and the other equity investments row names older accounting standards. Every other section, row and total is v7's.

sections.name: memo rows outside the statement's totals: a line takes a memo row only when that row's definition fits, else OUTSIDE

rows.name: Current assets
rows.definition: Computed by code as the sum of the eight current-asset rows, and checked against the filed current assets.

rows.name: Total assets
rows.definition: Computed by code as current assets plus the ten noncurrent-asset rows, operating-lease right-of-use assets included. The noncurrent-asset rows are checked against the filed noncurrent assets (as printed, or total assets less current assets, reconstructed); a code-only report check compares this total with total liabilities and capital.

rows.name: Current liabilities
rows.definition: Computed by code as the sum of the six current-liability rows, and checked against the filed current liabilities.

rows.name: Total liabilities
rows.definition: Computed by code as current liabilities plus the six noncurrent-liability rows; temporary equity is excluded. The noncurrent-liability rows are checked against the filed noncurrent liabilities (as printed, or total liabilities less current liabilities, reconstructed).

rows.name: Total liabilities and capital
rows.definition: Computed by code as total liabilities plus the six capital rows (temporary equity, parent common equity, preferred and non-controlling interests), and checked against the filed total liabilities and equity. The "commitments and contingencies" caption carries no amount.

rows.name: Operating payments
rows.definition: Operating cash paid, at the printed amounts, in a direct-method statement: to suppliers and employees, for interest, for income taxes, for operating leases and other operating payments. A printed net income-tax payment or refund line is kept as printed, without grossing up; refunds printed separately go to operating receipts.
belongs: payments to suppliers and employees
interest paid and income taxes paid
a printed net income-tax payment or refund line, kept as printed, not grossed up
operating lease payments, pension contributions, restructuring payments
other operating payments
a printed total of operating payments when no parts are printed

not_belongs.item: income tax refunds printed separately
discontinued operating cash flow printed as its own line

rows.name: Discontinued operations, operating cash flow, direct method
rows.definition: The operating cash flow of discontinued operations when a direct-method company prints it as its own line in the operating section, at its printed amount, only to the extent its cash flows are not already included in the operating receipts and payments counted above.
belongs: the discontinued operating cash flow line of a direct-method statement, as printed

not_belongs.item: one discontinued line covering all sections, printed after the three sections

rows.name: Consolidated permanent equity
rows.definition: Memo: the filed total equity of the group, parent plus non-controlling interests, temporary equity excluded, read as printed, not spread.
belongs: the printed "total equity" line

not_belongs.item: temporary preferred
redeemable non-controlling interests
other temporary equity

rows.name: Current pension and postretirement liability
rows.definition: Memo copy of the current liability for defined-benefit pension and other postretirement plans, from the face or the pension note. The amount itself stays in the row where the printed line went, usually Other current liabilities.
belongs: a copy of the current pension and other postretirement benefit liability, whose printed line sits in BS.CL.OTHER or another current-liability row

not_belongs.item: the noncurrent part
accrued defined-contribution and other payroll benefits

rows.name: Mandatorily redeemable shares, current
rows.definition: Memo copy of shares classified as current liabilities because they must be redeemed (mandatorily redeemable shares of any class), at the carrying amount printed on the face or in the note. The amount itself stays in the borrowing row where the printed line went (Short-term borrowings or Current portion of long-term borrowings).
belongs: a copy of mandatorily redeemable preferred and other mandatorily redeemable shares classified as current liabilities

not_belongs.item: holder-redeemable preferred in temporary equity
the noncurrent part
settlement amount and fair-value disclosures (note facts)

rows.name: Mandatorily redeemable shares, noncurrent
rows.definition: Memo copy of mandatorily redeemable shares of any class classified as noncurrent liabilities, at the carrying amount printed on the face or in the note. The amount itself stays in Long-term borrowings.
belongs: a copy of mandatorily redeemable preferred and other mandatorily redeemable shares classified as noncurrent liabilities

not_belongs.item: holder-redeemable preferred
the current part
fair-value disclosures

rows.name: Basic weighted-average shares
rows.definition: The weighted-average number of common shares used for basic earnings per share, as printed. When the company prints one figure for basic and diluted, that figure goes here and in Diluted weighted-average shares.
belongs: weighted-average basic shares or units
a single "basic and diluted" weighted-average share figure

not_belongs.item: shares outstanding at period end or on the cover page
diluted weighted-average shares

rows.name: Diluted weighted-average shares
rows.definition: The weighted-average number of shares used for diluted earnings per share, as printed. When the company prints one figure for basic and diluted, that figure goes here and in Basic weighted-average shares.
belongs: weighted-average diluted shares or units
a single "basic and diluted" weighted-average share figure

not_belongs.item: the incremental dilutive shares alone
basic weighted-average shares

rows.name: Basic EPS
rows.definition: Basic earnings per share on net income available to common, as printed. When the company prints one figure for basic and diluted, that figure goes here and in Diluted EPS. Never added to anything.
belongs: basic earnings per share on net income
a single "basic and diluted" earnings per share figure

not_belongs.item: per-share earnings from continuing operations and per-share discontinued operations
dividends per share
diluted earnings per share

rows.name: Diluted EPS
rows.definition: Diluted earnings per share on net income available to common, as printed. When the company prints one figure for basic and diluted, that figure goes here and in Basic EPS. Never added to anything.
belongs: diluted earnings per share on net income
a single "basic and diluted" earnings per share figure

not_belongs.item: per-share earnings from continuing operations and per-share discontinued operations
basic earnings per share

rows.name: D&A expense
rows.definition: Memo: depreciation, depletion and amortisation of property, plant and equipment, finance-lease right-of-use assets and intangible assets charged to income in the period, wherever it sits in the income statement, as given on the face or in the notes. A figure given only in the cash flow statement is not taken here.
belongs: a copy of depreciation and amortisation printed on the face, or inside cost of sales or SG&A when a note gives the amount
depletion
amortisation of acquired intangibles and of capitalised software
amortisation of finance-lease right-of-use assets

not_belongs.item: amortisation of debt discount and issuance costs
reduction of operating-lease right-of-use assets
impairment
the depreciation and amortisation add-back in the cash flow statement

rows.name: Capitalized interest
rows.definition: Memo: interest cost capitalised into the cost of assets in the period, as given in the notes or on the face.
belongs: interest capitalised during the period

not_belongs.item: total interest incurred, capitalised plus expensed
cash paid for capitalised interest, when printed in investing

rows.name: Restructuring
rows.definition: Memo copy of charges for exit or disposal activities under a restructuring plan recognised in the period, wherever printed, as given on the face or in the restructuring note. The amount itself stays in the statement row where the printed line went, usually Other operating income/expense.
belongs: severance and termination benefits under a restructuring plan
contract termination, facility closure and relocation costs under the plan
a restructuring charge that includes asset write-downs the note does not split, kept whole, marked mixed

not_belongs.item: asset write-downs the restructuring note gives separately
losses on selling assets under the plan, given separately
restructuring of discontinued operations

rows.name: Impairment
rows.definition: Memo copy of impairment charges on goodwill, intangible assets, property and equipment, right-of-use assets and equity-method investments recognised in the period, wherever printed, as given on the face or in the notes. The amount itself stays in the statement row where the printed line went.
belongs: goodwill impairment
impairment of intangible assets, in-process research and development from a business combination included
impairment of property, plant and equipment, long-lived assets held for use and right-of-use assets
impairment of equity-method investments
asset write-downs the restructuring note gives separately

not_belongs.item: inventory write-downs (they stay in cost of revenue)
credit-loss expense on receivables
impairment inside discontinued operations
a restructuring charge with write-downs the note does not split

rows.name: Disposal gain/loss
rows.definition: Memo copy of gains and losses on selling or disposing of property and equipment, intangible assets, businesses not reported as discontinued, and equity-method stakes, recognised in the period, wherever printed. The amount itself stays in the statement row where the printed line went.
belongs: gains and losses on sale of property, plant and equipment and intangibles
gains and losses on disposing of a business or disposal group not reported as discontinued
gains and losses on selling or disposing of an equity-method stake

not_belongs.item: gains and losses on debt and equity securities
gains and losses on extinguishing debt
disposal gains inside discontinued operations

rows.name: Litigation
rows.definition: Memo copy of losses and gains recognised in the period for lawsuits and claims, accruals and settlements alike, wherever printed, as given on the face or in the notes. The amount itself stays in the statement row where the printed line went.
belongs: litigation and claim accruals, including revisions of earlier estimates
litigation settlements, paid or received
a litigation line that includes legal fees the note does not split, kept whole, marked mixed

not_belongs.item: routine legal fees
the accrued litigation liability

rows.name: Operating lease cost
rows.definition: Memo: operating lease cost disclosed under ASC 842 in the lease note, excluding separately disclosed variable and short-term lease cost. The disclosed amount may include costs capitalised into another asset; whether it does is kept, and the whole amount is not described as expense charged to current-period income.
belongs: operating lease cost from the lease note, as disclosed, any part capitalised into another asset included

not_belongs.item: variable lease cost and short-term lease cost
finance lease interest
amortisation of finance-lease right-of-use assets
sublease income

rows.name: Cash interest paid, net of capitalized interest
rows.definition: Memo: cash paid for interest in the period, excluding interest capitalized, as the company discloses it. Establish the basis from the caption, surrounding disclosure and the reporting requirement applicable to that period. When the basis is inferred from that requirement, record it as inferred. Explicit disclosure of another basis takes precedence. If the basis remains unknown or conflicting, leave this row empty. A figure that includes capitalized interest, or whose basis is not established, does not fill this row; it stays a separately labelled note fact, and this row stays empty. No net amount is reconstructed from amounts disclosed apart.
belongs: "interest paid, net of amounts capitalized"
the supplemental cash-interest payment disclosed under the indirect cash-flow method in US GAAP, even when captioned only "interest paid", unless the filing identifies a different basis

not_belongs.item: interest paid including capitalized interest, or an "interest paid" figure whose basis remains unknown or conflicting (a labelled note fact)
cash paid for capitalized interest (not the same as interest capitalized in the period)
interest received (not netted here)
a net amount reconstructed from gross interest paid and interest capitalized disclosed apart

rows.name: Cash income taxes paid, net of refunds
rows.definition: Memo: cash paid for income taxes in the period, net of refunds, as the company discloses it. Establish the basis from the caption, surrounding disclosure and the reporting requirement applicable to that period. When the basis is inferred from that requirement, record it as inferred. Explicit disclosure of another basis takes precedence. If the basis remains unknown or conflicting, leave this row empty. A gross figure, or one whose basis is not established, does not fill this row; it stays a separately labelled note fact. No net amount is reconstructed from amounts disclosed apart.
belongs: "income taxes paid, net of refunds"
the annual cash-income-tax payment disclosed under the applicable net-of-refunds requirement, even when captioned only "income taxes paid", unless the filing identifies a different basis

not_belongs.item: income taxes paid before refunds, or an "income taxes paid" figure whose basis remains unknown or conflicting (a labelled note fact)
refunds disclosed on their own
non-income taxes
a net amount reconstructed from gross payments and refunds disclosed apart

report_checks.name: total assets against total liabilities and capital, as spread
report_checks.note: Both sides are totals of the spread's rows.

report_checks.name: total assets against total liabilities and equity, as filed
report_checks.note: Checks the filing, not the spread.

report_checks.name: cash rows against the filed cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash
report_checks.note: A difference can be restricted cash the filing prints inside other lines, so other rows hold it.

report_checks.name: equity rows including noncontrolling interest against the filed total equity
report_checks.note: Unavailable when the filing prints no total equity including noncontrolling interest.

report_checks.name: cash flow ending cash against balance sheet cash and restricted cash
report_checks.note: Needs two statements; one run reads one statement.

report_checks.name: income statement net income against the cash flow statement's starting net income
report_checks.note: Needs two statements; one run reads one statement.
